title: NextBrain Case 2 · Midbrain B1.1
units_evidence: The author documents nominal 0.1 mm in-plane reconstructed histology and 0.4 mm ex vivo MRI. The original scanner NIfTI declares millimeters. The supplied processed MRI and label affines retain their source rotation, spacing and block reconstruction in the case RAS frame.

space.correspondence: Source reconstructed histological block B1.1 and ex vivo T2 MRI retain their supplied NIfTI grids in case P41-16 RAS coordinates. Histology supplies fine assignments; the source-processed MRI supplies spatial context.

label_table.evidence: Source histology delineation with author MRI-guided reconstruction, supplied as a categorical NIfTI block. Source methods combine manual work and computational processing, followed by author checking.
source_notes: Case 2 P41-16; source block B1.1 (browser block 7). The source publication reports a right hemisphere and no incidental findings for this case.
Structures show their delivered extent within block B1.1. Block-edge surfaces mark the limits of this tissue sample.
Native source samples and affine geometry are retained. Surface display uses the categorical boundary at half-voxel level.
Label-specific side is explicit only where the original source name supplies it. Case hemisphere and regional laterality are recorded separately.
